findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: import_portfolio, get_dart_financials, get_dart_filings, get_dart_major_events, get_edgar_filings, get_edgar_insider_trades, get_disclosure_feed, get_edgar_13f · Private data: screen_etfs, import_portfolio, get_portfolio, search_dart_company, get_dart_financials, get_dart_document, get_dart_major_events, search_edgar_company, get_edgar_financials, get_edgar_filings, get_db_schema, query_db, get_stock_prices, get_tw_insider_transfers, get_valuation, get_disclosure_feed · Public sink: get_dart_financials, get_dart_insider_trades, get_edgar_financials, get_tw_insider_transfers, get_valuation · Destructive: screen_etfs, import_portfolio, manage_watchlist, get_dart_financials, get_dart_filings, get_db_schema, query_db.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: import_portfolio, get_dart_financials, get_dart_filings, get_dart_major_events, get_edgar_filings, get_edgar_insider_trades, get_disclosure_feed, get_edgar_13f · Private data: screen_etfs, import_portfolio, get_portfolio, search_dart_company, get_dart_financials, get_dart_document, get_dart_major_events, search_edgar_company, get_edgar_financials, get_edgar_filings, get_db_schema, query_db, get_stock_prices, get_tw_insider_transfers, get_valuation, get_disclosure_feed · Public sink: get_dart_financials, get_dart_insider_trades, get_edgar_financials, get_tw_insider_transfers, get_valuation · Destructive: screen_etfs, import_portfolio, manage_watchlist, get_dart_financials, get_dart_filings, get_db_schema, query_db

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
